---
title: "R Packages"
description: "Documentation and vignettes for 10 actively maintained R packages covering regression diagnostics, customer segmentation, descriptive statistics, inference and data binning."
---

All ten packages below are on CRAN and documented. Each link opens the
package's reference site; every one is maintained and versioned with CRAN.

## Regression and modeling

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-olsrr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the olsrr R package"}

### olsrr {.card-title}

Tools for building OLS regression models. Coefficient diagnostics, ANOVA
tables, influential observation analysis, model comparison and more.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=olsrr)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/olsrr)
- [Docs](https://olsrr.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-blorr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the blorr R package"}

### blorr {.card-title}

Tools for developing binary logistic regression models. Includes
comprehensive regression output, model fit statistics and validation
measures.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=blorr)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/blorr)
- [Docs](https://blorr.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-xplorerr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the xplorerr R package"}

### xplorerr {.card-title}

Interactive data exploration and visualization. Correlation heatmaps,
scatterplots, normality and outlier checks, and regression modeling from a
point-and-click interface.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=xplorerr)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/xplorerr)
- [Docs](https://xplorerr.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

## Descriptive and inferential statistics

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-descriptr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the descriptr R package"}

### descriptr {.card-title}

Generate and visualize descriptive statistics for numeric and categorical
data. Frequency tables, skewness, kurtosis, key statistics and interactive
plots, all at speed.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=descriptr)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/descriptr)
- [Docs](https://descriptr.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-inferr.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the inferr R package"}

### inferr {.card-title}

Hypothesis testing and inference. Parametric and non-parametric tests with
structured, readable output — t-test, chi-square, ANOVA, correlation and
more.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=inferr)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/aravindhebbali/inferr)
- [Docs](https://inferr.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-vistributions.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the vistributions R package"}

### vistributions {.card-title}

Visualize probability distributions of univariate data across 20+
continuous and discrete distributions, plus statistical quality checks.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=vistributions)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/vistributions)
- [Docs](https://vistributions.rsquaredacademy.com)
:::
:::

## Data wrangling

::: {.card-deck}
::: {.card}
![](../images/hex-rbin.webp){.hex alt="Hex sticker for the rbin R package"}

### rbin {.card-title}

Bin and group numeric data into intervals. Equidistant, quantile, quantile
binning and custom breaks, with an easy-to-use interactive mode.

- [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rbin)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/rbin)
:::
:::

## Archived

::: {.callout-warning}
### nse2r — archived, under revival

`nse2r` fetched live data from the National Stock Exchange of India. It was
**archived on CRAN on 2023-08-07** at the maintainer's request and is
currently being revived, so it is no longer installable from CRAN.

Its ~22,000 historical downloads remain part of the totals quoted elsewhere
on this site, but that figure is frozen and will not grow. Source and issue
tracker: [github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/nse2r).
:::
